ca-sainte-angele-de-merici-quebec-gite-d.name: 4e Rang de Fleuriau courtyard Eiffel replica
ca-sainte-angele-de-merici-quebec-gite-d.summary: A brown Eiffel-shaped tower stands in a landscaped courtyard east of 4e Rang de Fleuriau, along Route 234. September 2024 Street View shows it behind an animal sculpture and trees as part of the garden setting. This matches the viewing region in the older Gîte de la Tour Eiffel inventory. The guesthouse listings use number 180 while Street View automatically labels the road position 164; the cadastral connection and present operator remain unconfirmed, as do the tower's maker and construction year.
